budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Plan, track and pay for everything in one place.
budget.startWithTotal: Start with 16 common categories. We’ll split your total the way most couples do, and you can change everything.
budget.startNoTotal: Set your total above, then start with 16 common categories (we’ll suggest how to split it), or build your own.
budget.unallocated: {amount} of your total isn’t allocated to a category yet.
budget.overAllocated: Your categories add up to {amount} more than your total budget.
budget.committedHint: Actual prices, or estimates where not known
budget.totalHint: Everything you plan to spend, all in.
budget.daysOverdue: {count, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}
budget.deleteCategoryText: {count, plural, =0 {This category has no expenses.} one {Its # expense, its payments and receipt will be deleted too.} other {Its # expenses, their payments and receipts will be deleted too.}}
budget.categoryHint: How much do you plan to spend on it?
budget.name: Name

charts.noSpend: Add expenses to see where the money goes.
charts.donutLabel: Donut chart of spending by category. Amounts are listed beside it.
charts.barLabel: Bar chart of planned and committed amounts per category. The category list below has the same numbers.

sheet.hint: Use the estimate while you’re planning; add the actual price once it’s agreed.
sheet.actualHint: Leave empty until you know it.
sheet.paymentsHint: Add deposits and instalments with their due dates. You’ll see upcoming ones on the budget page.
sheet.deleteText: Its payments and receipt will be deleted too.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.description: Photographer, florist, DJ… everyone you’re talking to, in one place.
vendors.emptyText: Keep contact details, quotes and contracts together, and link them to your budget.
vendors.notLinked: Not linked to any expense yet.
vendors.deleteText: Their contract file is deleted. Budget expenses linked to them stay in your budget.
